This section sets out the main rule first, then the reasons

Companion Animal Travel Desk: routine welfare and handoff care

This section keeps every animal booking calm, safe, and clear from first contact through handoff. The main rule is simple: protect the animal's welfare before convenience, and make sure every service change is recorded in the desk ledger right away. Staff should speak in plain words, check travel papers with care, and keep the traveler informed without adding extra worry. If a carrier needs to move between services, the ground team must handle it gently and confirm that the animal is secure before the next step begins.

The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions and should be told at once about any concern, delay, or special need. If the traveler arrives with a pet such as Daisy, staff should note the condition of the carrier, the mood of the animal, and any instructions that affect feeding, rest, or comfort. Use a steady hand and a kind tone at every point, because small choices can make the whole journey easier. When a booking changes, the desk should update the record first, then pass the same clear message to the next team.

Staff must never guess about an animal's needs or leave a carrier unattended in a busy area. If the situation seems unclear, pause the process and ask the senior coordinator before moving ahead. Good notes, careful listening, and gentle transfer habits help Aurelia Skyways keep trust with every traveler and pet.

For anything unusual, contact the senior coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
